extracted.intended_audience: prospective IMO participants, team leaders, host organisers, and general public
extracted.subtask_description: Overview information and basic procedural requirements for the International Mathematical Olympiad (IMO), including eligibility, organisational responsibilities, and data‑protection/anonymity procedures.

rubrics_metrics.name: Eligibility — high school students
rubrics_metrics.description: The International Mathematical Olympiad (IMO) is the World Championship Mathematics Competition for High School students and is held annually in a different country.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Implied requirement: participants are high school students; the competition is organised yearly by a host country.

rubrics_metrics.name: Host country observance of IMO regulations and traditions
rubrics_metrics.description: The IMO Board ensures that the competition takes place each year and that each host country observes the regulations and traditions of the IMO.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Organisational responsibility: host countries must follow IMO regulations and traditions as overseen by the IMO Board.

rubrics_metrics.name: Data protection and participant anonymity procedure
rubrics_metrics.description: Data is held at IMO-official in compliance with EU data protection legislation. If a participant wishes to become anonymous (neither photo nor name on public display), then contact the IMO secretary with a request. We will comply with bona fide requests expeditiously.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Procedure: participants may request anonymity by contacting the IMO secretary; the site affirms compliance with EU data protection rules and promises prompt handling of genuine requests.
